notes.title: Achievements & Challenges
notes.content:
It's been a little while but now it's time for a surprise update in celebration of Irradiant hitting over 400 leaderboard entries. Originally this update was going to just add achievements, but that felt a bit lame - so instead I've included some new challenges and a new unlockable mode. I hope you have fun discovering the new content!

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Nineteen achievements have been added.
[*] Score based achievements are retroactively earned on launch based on your high score.
[/list]
[h3]New Mode: Trials[/h3]
[list]
[*] Four new trial challenges have been added.
[*] Trial of Water disables slash attacks - no quick kills on Obonyas now!
[*] Trial of Stone disables dashing - positioning and control become more important!
[*] Trial of Air disables heavy attacks - Monotori and Ryoujin are trickier to deal with!
[*] Trial of Fire disables light attacks - race to make sure you kill Iriguchi before they clam up!
[/list]
[h3]New Mode: Master Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new unlockable mode that modifies enemies for a truly merciless experience.
[*] I'll leave it up to players to discover the changes in Master Mode.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Quick restart now also works on victory and defeat screens.
[/list]

 This will probably be the last non-bug fix update but be on the look out for my next games!

notes.title: Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
This update ended up being a lot more involved than I first thought, but finally there's rebinding controls!

[list]
[*] Added the ability to browse through multiple pages in the top leaderboard.
[*] Added quick restart (defaults to "R" on keyboard and unbound on controllers) which lets you quickly restart a run without confirmation.
[*] Added controls section to settings where you can rebind keyboard and controller inputs.
[*] Instructions throughout the game are now dynamic and reflect what key/button you've bound actions to.
[*] Please note if you previously customized the controls by hand they'll be reset on first launch after the update.
[*] Leaderboard names with characters not in the custom font will display "?", rather than misaligned boxes.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.2
notes.content:
Apologies for the update spam and not catching the root issue for this crash sooner!

[list]
[*] Fixed seg-fault crash when spawning the boss if an obonya (lantern) had some of its kaenya (wisps) already defeated.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
Thanks to Eglaios for catching this!

[list]
[*] Itazurakkos (imps) now only spawn from the first opening of iriguchis (mouths). After that only koumori (bats) will spawn.
[*] Note that previous recordings will not show this change in order to not disrupt current scores.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
Quick update to cover some requests.

[list]
[*] Victory and defeat screens now tells the player if they got a new high score and their new ranking.
[*] Player's global rank is displayed alongside their score, in the top right, whilst playing.
[*] Pressing menu/escape while playing will now warn the player that they need to press menu/escape again to quit to avoid nasty surprise that pausing isn't supported.
[*] Added a "controls.kohi" file which can be edited in any text editor to rebind keyboard controls. In future will investigate spending time exposing these in settings UI.
[*] Fixed a rare crash on reaching the boss.
[/list]
